dog.description_text: Meet Webby — New Arrival! Webby just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far from his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FWebby%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQorT3usq6xuTa0SewkNE%5FyLEgUDBmOMO4812M0nJ19xNND1eQ His foster says "He loves churus and treats and will get to know you best by sitting quietly with him at first. He loves to snuggle and be pet once he feels safe! He is very calm and mellow around my resident cat. He’s very observant and curious - I love watching him watch my cat run around. " He is playful and affectionate. Webby is a 5 month old male kitten. He has been neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. If you’re open to a little patience and a lot of possibility, come meet Webby! You might be the person who helps them feel safe, confident, and right at home. Check back for updates—or stop by to say hello and discover who Webby is becoming.
dog.name: Webby
